inputs.text: SSANU’s one-month ultimatum looks like a pressure point in a drawn-out standoff: the federal government has let the 2009 agreement renegotiation drag on, and now the union is warning that the disruption could spread nationwide. These delays and threats may be serving the interests of those who benefit from keeping university workers divided and the issue unresolved.
